methods.label: Observed monthly values
methods.description: Original monthly exports and imports, with indicators calculated from those flows.

methods.label: 3-month trailing average
methods.description: Mean of the current month and preceding two months; complete windows only.

methods.label: 6-month trailing average
methods.description: Mean of the current month and preceding five months; complete windows only.

methods.label: 12-month trailing average
methods.description: Mean of the current month and preceding eleven months; complete windows only. This smooth series lags turning points.

methods.label: Centered 12-month average (2 × 12)
methods.description: Average of two adjacent 12-month means: weights 1/24 at t−6 and t+6, and 1/12 at t−5 through t+5. The first and last six months are unavailable.

methods.label: HP trend (λ = 129,600)
methods.description: Two-sided Hodrick–Prescott trend fitted to monthly flow levels over each complete contiguous sample, using λ = 129,600. At least 24 consecutive observed months are required.
